mcd17-1.flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

mcd17-2.flavorText: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon.

mcd17-3.flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

mcd17-4.flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

attacks.name: Thunder Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

mcd17-5.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

mcd17-6.flavorText: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

mcd17-7.flavorText: It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly. What little meat they contain is rich and delicious.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

mcd17-8.flavorText: This Pokémon was not originally found in Alola. Human actions caused a surge in their numbers, and they went feral. They're prideful and crafty.

attacks.name: Spelunk
attacks.text: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back in any order.

mcd17-9.flavorText: Its head sports an altered form of whiskers made of metal. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

attacks.name: Fly Around
attacks.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

mcd17-10.flavorText: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

attacks.name: Rock Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

mcd17-11.flavorText: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth.

mcd17-12.flavorText: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.
